full_report: Patient P4 is a 71-year-old with EGFR-mutant NSCLC. Tumor mutation burden is elevated at 12.5 mut/Mb. ctDNA level is rising, now 6.2 ng/mL. Creatinine is stable at 1.6 mg/dL. ALT is elevated at 60 U/L, suggesting mild hepatic stress. Patient reports fatigue but no acute distress. Current regimen is osimertinib 80mg daily. Recommend continued monitoring with liver panel in 2 weeks. No dose change needed at this time.
